svg.text: the arcades at 9, 15 and 21 m, the courtyard wall at 27 m; the glazed vault on the first ring; the June mark 24.2 m north
Attempt #10: 61.2 m × 61.2 m. The floor steps in their metals, the results in gold; above, in grey, the arches, flying arches and vault ribs; the courtyard wall in stone.
